verdict: NOT CERTIFIED - all machine-verifiable gates pass, but CERTIFY-001 requires an INDEPENDENT verifier
blockingReasons: Every line of production code, every test, and this self-attack were written by the same agent. Self-certification is not verification.
The Devil's Advocate run below is self-directed, so it cannot satisfy 'Independent Devil's Advocate run'.

hygiene.activeLegacyImports: none (frontend authController.ts deleted, archive dir not imported)
hygiene.directStockWrites: exactly one boundary: transaction.service.ts applyStockDeltas; no raw SQL touches stock

findings.title: Stock can go negative through an over-issue
findings.detail: A movement of 999 against a balance of 10 is accepted (201) and leaves currentStock = -989.000. The ledger stays arithmetically consistent (10 - 999 = -989), but nothing in the tree refuses a negative balance.
findings.status: OPEN - this is a business-policy decision, not a defect I can decide unilaterally. Needs an explicit rule: refuse, or clamp, or require an admin stock adjustment.

findings.title: The stock-adjustment write path still coerced quantity through Number()
findings.detail: DATA-001 converted the ordinary movement path but left POST /transactions/stock-adjustments doing quantity: Number(dto.quantity), and PATCH /transactions/:id computed the stock correction as newDelta - oldDelta in a float.
findings.fix: Both now parse through parseDecimal and the update path subtracts two Prisma.Decimal values. Proven: correcting 0.1 to 0.7 leaves exactly 0.700, not 0.5999999999999999.
findings.status: FIXED - guarded by data-001-contract and stock-adjustment-contract, and by a new E2E probe.

findings.title: The backup restore gate refused every real backup
findings.detail: assertManifestIsRestorable threw whenever a dump declared a checksum, which every real full backup does, so every HTTP restore returned 400. OPS-001's E2E missed it because it called pg_restore directly.
findings.fix: The gate now refuses only a dump with no checksum; the real verification stays in assertManifestChecksums, which has the payload bytes.
findings.status: FIXED - an applied restore against the live database now succeeds.

findings.title: BACKUP_RESTORE_PIN was never configured or passed to the container
findings.detail: POST /api/backup/restore answered 401 for every caller, so the restore path was unreachable in this deployment.
findings.fix: Added to .env (gitignored) and to docker-compose.yml as a required variable.

findings.title: Two E2E specs asserted Decimals as JavaScript numbers
findings.detail: inventory-boundary and stock-adjustment compared currentStock with toBe(0)/toBe(3.5) and posted quantity as a float. After DATA-001 the API returns strings, so these specs were asserting the old contract rather than catching a real regression.
findings.fix: Specs now post decimal strings and compare the string form.
findings.status: FIXED - but note this is exactly the kind of spec that hides a breaking change instead of reporting it.

notProven: The Service Worker's own fetch cannot be cut by setOfflineMode, CDP emulation, or request interception, so a genuine mid-request network interruption in the browser is unproven. The durable queue itself is proven by tests/e2e/offline-queue.spec.ts.

docker compose build (the default target) still fails in this environment because the Chrome download for Puppeteer is blocked. All verification used --target production, which is the same application code without the browser tooling.
